observations: The chat answers correctly report Gaya at +8.0 percentage points and Nalanda at +7.0, and correctly refuse to invent a cause from the aggregate synthetic data.

The served page returns HTTP 200 but its initial render throws `r.toFixed is not a function`; all chart bars, summary values, table rows, and worked example remain blank. This is treated as application_not_openable because the dashboard's primary data interface never becomes usable.
The year buttons and page shell are visible and responsive, but changing year cannot recover the failed render.
The delivered Gaya/Nalanda CSV has correct 2021 and 2023 endpoints and changes, but omits the required 2022 observations and source field.
The page visibly and honestly labels the data as a synthetic fixture and includes the correct rate formula even though the live example fails to render.
The dependency-free shell has no narrow viewport overflow and behaves identically offline; those strengths do not compensate for missing data content.

Cline said it performed a visual review and extensive Node validation, but neither caught the browser runtime type error. This supports retaining real Playwright rendering as a hard benchmark requirement.

The five turns took 676.674 seconds. All 23 provider calls resolved to qwen/qwen3.8-27b (22 Reka, one Alibaba), cost USD 0.44239855, and used 716,033 prompt plus 36,117 completion tokens including 14,894 reasoning tokens.
evidence_notes: The score is unblinded and provisional until paired review; the runtime error and missing CSV observations are deterministic findings.
